title: Some Plasma Style paddings don't update on Style change until plasmashell is restarted
line: After switching Plasma Style, the Application Launcher's separators, list spacing and scroll bars now match the new style right away instead of after a restart.
explanation: Kickoff read the line SVG's separator sizes with elementSize() in a binding, which is never re-evaluated, so after a live style switch separators kept the old style's thickness and row spacing (Breeze after Oxygen gets a thick 3 px separator). Its sidebar ListView also kept the contentX for the old leftMargin when the dialog padding changed (QTBUG-131478), shifting every row by 2 px. PlasmaComponents ScrollBar had the same problem with its hint-scrollbar-size, private-hint-show-separator and hasElement() inset checks. Kickoff now re-reads the sizes on repaintNeeded and resets contentX when leftMargin changes; ScrollBar caches the hints in properties refreshed on repaintNeeded and reads the insets straight from the frames (-1 means no hint), which notify on style change.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: Update separator sizes and list margins on style change

Kickoff read its separator sizes from the Plasma Style only once, and
its lists kept their old offset when their margins changed after a live
style switch. Re-read the sizes on style change and reset the offset.

BUG: 503305

PC3/ScrollBar: Update size hints and insets on style change

The scroll bar read its size hint, separator hint and insets from the
Plasma Style once, so after a live style switch it kept the old style's
width and position. Read the insets from the frames and refresh the rest.

BUG: 503305

patches.diff:
From be8bdbc405cca24fb10f6399da707e4ca6528fe2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:52:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] PC3/ScrollBar: Update size hints and insets on style change

The scroll bar read its size hint, separator hint and insets from the
Plasma Style once, so after a live style switch it kept the old style's
width and position. Read the insets from the frames and refresh the rest.

BUG: 503305
---
 .../plasmacomponents3/ScrollBar.qml           | 34 +++++++++++--------
 1 file changed, 20 insertions(+), 14 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ScrollBar.qml b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ScrollBar.qml
index 5e0b1fb2d..57081504e 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ScrollBar.qml
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/plasmacomponents3/ScrollBar.qml
@@ -31,14 +31,14 @@ T.ScrollBar {
 
     // Working around weird default values for `margins` (== `fixedMargins`) and `inset` (== -1)
     // TODO KF6: Use 0 as the default value for inset and margins
-    leftPadding: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${handle.usedPrefix}-hint-left-inset`) ? handle.inset.left : horizontalPadding
-    rightPadding: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${handle.usedPrefix}-hint-right-inset`) ? handle.inset.right : horizontalPadding
-    topPadding: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${handle.usedPrefix}-hint-top-inset`) ? handle.inset.top : verticalPadding
-    bottomPadding: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${handle.usedPrefix}-hint-bottom-inset`) ? handle.inset.bottom : verticalPadding
-    leftInset: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${bgFrame.usedPrefix}-hint-left-inset`) ? bgFrame.inset.left : 0
-    rightInset: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${bgFrame.usedPrefix}-hint-right-inset`) ? bgFrame.inset.right : 0
-    topInset: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${bgFrame.usedPrefix}-hint-top-inset`) ? bgFrame.inset.top : 0
-    bottomInset: scrollbarSvg.hasElement(`${bgFrame.usedPrefix}-hint-bottom-inset`) ? bgFrame.inset.bottom : 0
+    leftPadding: handle.inset.left >= 0 ? handle.inset.left : horizontalPadding
+    rightPadding: handle.inset.right >= 0 ? handle.inset.right : horizontalPadding
+    topPadding: handle.inset.top >= 0 ? handle.inset.top : verticalPadding
+    bottomPadding: handle.inset.bottom >= 0 ? handle.inset.bottom : verticalPadding
+    leftInset: bgFrame.inset.left >= 0 ? bgFrame.inset.left : 0
+    rightInset: bgFrame.inset.right >= 0 ? bgFrame.inset.right : 0
+    topInset: bgFrame.inset.top >= 0 ? bgFrame.inset.top : 0
+    bottomInset: bgFrame.inset.bottom >= 0 ? bgFrame.inset.bottom : 0
 
     Rectangle {
         id: separator
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@ T.ScrollBar {
         // Technically, there's nothing stopping theme authors from using this
         // anyway, but I don't want to have to support it long term until we're
         // sure we want this.
-        visible: scrollbarSvg.hasElement("private-hint-show-separator")
+        visible: scrollbarSvg.showSeparator
             && controlRoot.interactive
             && (controlRoot.mirrored ? controlRoot.rightInset > 0 : controlRoot.leftInset > 0)
         implicitWidth: 1
@@ -61,8 +61,8 @@ T.ScrollBar {
 
     background: KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
         id: bgFrame
-        implicitWidth: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size").width, fixedMargins.left + fixedMargins.right)
-        implicitHeight: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size").height, fixedMargins.top + fixedMargins.bottom)
+        implicitWidth: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.hintSize.width, fixedMargins.left + fixedMargins.right)
+        implicitHeight: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.hintSize.height, fixedMargins.top + fixedMargins.bottom)
         imagePath:"widgets/scrollbar"
         prefix: controlRoot.horizontal ? "background-horizontal" : "background-vertical"
         opacity: controlRoot.enabled && controlRoot.hovered && controlRoot.interactive
@@ -101,8 +101,8 @@ T.ScrollBar {
     contentItem: KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
         id: handle
         imagePath:"widgets/scrollbar"
-        implicitWidth: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size").width, fixedMargins.left + fixedMargins.right)
-        implicitHeight: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size").height, fixedMargins.top + fixedMargins.bottom)
+        implicitWidth: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.hintSize.width, fixedMargins.left + fixedMargins.right)
+        implicitHeight: Math.max(scrollbarSvg.hintSize.height, fixedMargins.top + fixedMargins.bottom)
         prefix: controlRoot.interactive && (controlRoot.pressed || (controlRoot.enabled && controlRoot.hovered) ) && controlRoot.enabled ? "mouseover-slider" : "slider"
         opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
     }
@@ -112,7 +112,13 @@ T.ScrollBar {
         imagePath: "widgets/scrollbar"
         //TODO: support arrows?
         property bool arrowPresent: scrollbarSvg.hasElement("arrow-up")
+        property size hintSize: scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size")
+        property bool showSeparator: scrollbarSvg.hasElement("private-hint-show-separator")
         //new theme may be different
-        onRepaintNeeded: arrowPresent = scrollbarSvg.hasElement("arrow-up")
+        onRepaintNeeded: {
+            arrowPresent = scrollbarSvg.hasElement("arrow-up");
+            hintSize = scrollbarSvg.elementSize("hint-scrollbar-size");
+            showSeparator = scrollbarSvg.hasElement("private-hint-show-separator");
+        }
     }
 }
-- 
2.53.0

From efdc872ca558fc255bd4d3376ae9fb137a0c305c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:52:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: Update separator sizes and list margins on
 style change

Kickoff read its separator sizes from the Plasma Style only once, and
its lists kept their old offset when their margins changed after a live
style switch. Re-read the sizes on style change and reset the offset.

BUG: 503305
---
 applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml  | 2 ++
 applets/kickoff/KickoffSingleton.qml | 4 ++++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
index 839ea277e8..7d06649b5a 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
@@ -112,6 +112,8 @@ EmptyPage {
 
         leftMargin: kickoff.backgroundMetrics.leftPadding
         rightMargin: kickoff.backgroundMetrics.rightPadding
+        // contentX isn't always updated when the margins change (QTBUG-131478)
+        onLeftMarginChanged: contentX = -leftMargin
 
         currentIndex: count > 0 ? 0 : -1
         focus: true
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/KickoffSingleton.qml b/applets/kickoff/KickoffSingleton.qml
index 8810a75b7f..a45aac04e8 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/KickoffSingleton.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/KickoffSingleton.qml
@@ -36,6 +36,10 @@ Item {
         imagePath: "widgets/line"
         property int horLineHeight: elementSize("horizontal-line").height
         property int vertLineWidth: elementSize("vertical-line").width
+        onRepaintNeeded: {
+            horLineHeight = elementSize("horizontal-line").height;
+            vertLineWidth = elementSize("vertical-line").width;
+        }
     }
     //END
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Kickoff after switching Oxygen → Breeze live (left) vs after a plasmashell restart (right): thick separator, taller separator row, rows shifted 2 px right.
Same steps with the fix: the live switch matches the restarted shell.
Kickoff after switching Breeze → Oxygen live (left) vs after restart (right): separator row 2 px short, rows shifted left, scroll bar keeps Breeze's narrower width.
Same steps with the fix: identical to the restarted shell.
